title: Functions [Helper]
description:
In this lesson, you will write a _helper function_. A helper function is just a function that is made to break up a big block of code into smaller code.
## Assignment:
We want a function that will determine the add rev of out users!
Write the getAddRevenue function: it shoud take 4 numbers: addSpend, conversions, clicks, and perAddRev. To get the conversion rate devide conversions by clicks, to get the total addSpend divide addSpend by conversions and then return the result of subtracting conversion rate by totalAddSpend then multipliying it by perAddRev
